name: Water Whip
description:
Roll Spirit vs Dexterity against a creature within short range. On a win, they take 1d8 damage. Half on a loss.

Either way, check a condition.

Describe your water whip.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

✨: You may target one additional creature within range.

🌞: They are knocked prone.

💀: -1d damage. Check an additional condition.
